evidence.outcome: Vite production build passes with only non-blocking third-party annotation warnings.
Roles serialize as lowercase strings and numeric enum values are rejected.
Owner/admin can select mod checkboxes while server runs; mutations remain stopped-state gated.
Long mod titles and summaries wrap safely and checkbox sizing is fixed.

next_slice.summary: Ready for independent QA and Docker verification.

result: Implemented API role-string serialization, mod selection with stopped-state mutation gating, overflow-safe mod cards, checkbox styling, and regression coverage.
